== Strategy ==

I was under the impression (and I guess everyone I played) that every "System location" meant "every location at a system" (as logic would suggest if they meant every system, why not just say every system?) which meant that Echo Base Operations + Main Power Generators = Unstoppable.  Which of course boggled my mind as to why anyone would use air in such a wonderfully constructed ground deck.

Final note - this isn't really a deck, I just don't know how to delete this, so I figured I'd offer an explination, and possibly good advice to someone who has made the same mistake, as from experience I see I'm not the only one who is mistaken.
